title: Welcome to Cobble
intro: Three quick steps to get ready. You can skip any of them and come back later from the Store and Settings.

machine.title: Your machine
machine.detected: This machine has {{ram}} of memory and {{gpu}}.
machine.noPack: No starter pack fits this machine. You can still pick modules one by one in the Store.

model.title: A model service
model.description: Cobble needs a language model to plan and write your apps. Connect a service with your own API key, or keep the demo model to look around.

project.title: Your first project
project.description: Start with an example to see the whole loop: Cobble asks a few questions, writes a plan, builds it, and shows you a demo.
project.examplePrompt: Create a simple to-do list app: add tasks, mark them done, delete them.
